pii_audit.notes: No consumer PII (SSN, DOB, financial accounts) detected across all 21,003 rows. Automated scan for SSN patterns (XXX-XX-XXXX) and DOB patterns returned zero matches. Dataset contains 23 columns, all business-related: dealer_name, dba_name, license_type, license_number, owner_principal, address, city, state, zip, phone, license_status, issue_date, expiration_date, county, email, dealer_type, mailing_address, mailing_city, mailing_state, mailing_zip, bond_company, source_file, _quality_flag. The owner_principal field is populated for only 324 records (1.5%), all Manufacturers & Distributors — these are corporate officers listed on public business licenses (e.g., 'Patricia Reed | Navistar, Inc.'), not consumer data. 3,055 dealer_name entries appear to be individual sole-proprietor names operating as licensed GDN dealers — these are public licensees, not consumers. 57.9% of emails use personal domains (gmail, yahoo, etc.), which is standard for small independent dealers using personal email as their business contact. 336 mailing addresses with residential indicators (APT/UNIT/LOT) that differ from business addresses were found; however, these are mailing addresses voluntarily submitted as part of the public license application and published by TxDMV on its public portal. All phone numbers are business contact phones listed on the license. No SSN, DOB, financial account, or medical information present.

public_domain.notes: Data sourced from the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) dealer licensing portal at https://texasdmv.my.salesforce-sites.com/dealers. This is a state government agency public records portal. No authentication, login, or account creation is required to access the data. TxDMV publishes downloadable XLS spreadsheets for each dealer category (Motor Vehicle Dealers, Salvage Dealers, Manufacturers, RV Manufacturers), updated daily, explicitly for public use. Data was obtained via direct file download links from the Salesforce-hosted portal. The portal exists specifically to make dealer licensing information available to the public for consumer protection purposes under Texas Occupations Code Chapter 2301 and Texas Transportation Code Chapter 503.

tos_compliance.notes: The TxDMV dealer lookup portal (texasdmv.my.salesforce-sites.com/dealers) is a government public records portal that publishes downloadable data files explicitly for public consumption. No Terms of Service restricting commercial use are posted on the portal pages. The data files are offered as direct downloads (XLS format) without click-through agreements, usage restrictions, or license terms. As a Texas state government portal, it falls under the Texas Public Information Act (Chapter 552, Texas Government Code), which establishes that government information is presumed to be available to the public. No robots.txt restrictions apply to the download endpoints. Harvest method was direct file download, not scraping.

copyright.notes: Texas state government works are not subject to copyright protection under U.S. copyright law principles analogous to 17 USC § 105 (federal works). While states are not explicitly covered by § 105, Texas does not claim copyright on its public records and publishes this data freely. The data consists of factual regulatory records (license numbers, business names, addresses, statuses) — factual compilations receive only thin copyright protection under Feist v. Rural Telephone (1991), and our dataset is independently cleaned, standardized, and restructured rather than a verbatim reproduction. TxDMV does not assert any database rights or sui generis protection. The value-add is in cleaning, standardizing, and restructuring data from 4 separate source files into a unified schema.

putnam_test.notes: Would a reasonable licensed auto dealer feel harmed by inclusion in this dataset? No. These are businesses that (1) applied for and obtained a state license specifically to conduct business with the public, (2) are required by law to display their license at their place of business, (3) voluntarily submitted all listed information as part of their license application knowing it would be public record, and (4) generally want to be discoverable by potential customers, partners, and vendors. The 3,055 sole-proprietor dealers operating under personal names chose to register their personal name as the business entity. The dataset serves B2B purposes (CRM vendors, parts suppliers, lenders finding dealerships) that align with dealers' business interests. No sensitive or embarrassing information is included — only standard business licensing data.

gdpr_ccpa.notes: GDPR: Not applicable. Dataset contains Texas-licensed businesses only. While some Manufacturers & Distributors are based in other U.S. states (California, Indiana, etc.), none are EU-based entities or EU residents. No EU personal data is present. CCPA: California's 'publicly available' exemption (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.140(v)(2)) applies — information lawfully made available from federal, state, or local government records is excluded from the definition of 'personal information' under CCPA. All data in this dataset was published by TxDMV as government public records. Additionally, CCPA primarily protects California consumers/residents; this is Texas business licensing data. The sole-proprietor names and mailing addresses, while technically identifying information, are government public records voluntarily submitted as part of commercial licensing and thus fall under the public records exemption.

completeness.notes: Dataset contains 21,003 cleaned rows (21,004 lines including header), derived from 22,133 raw records after removing 1,130 duplicates. Source breakdown: 15,383 Independent GDN dealers + 4,566 Franchised dealers + 728 Salvage dealers + 222 Manufacturers + 104 Distributors = 21,003 total. This represents the complete TxDMV dealer licensing database across all 4 published source files as of 2026-05-27. Key field completeness: dealer_name 100%, license_number 100%, license_status 100%, address 100%, city 100%, zip 100%, phone 97.8%, email 94.8%, expiration_date 100%. Status breakdown: 19,073 Active + 1,530 Active-Pending Renewal + 400 Expired = 21,003. The 400 expired records are retained and flagged for historical analysis value. Row count is materially consistent with the source (22,133 raw minus 1,130 deduped = 21,003). This is not a sample — it is the full population of TxDMV-licensed dealers.

notes: All 7 compliance checks PASS. Dataset is sourced from a Texas state government public records portal, contains no consumer PII, does not violate any Terms of Service, is not copyright-protected, passes the Putnam test for business licensing data, is exempt from GDPR/CCPA personal data provisions, and is materially complete. APPROVED for product packaging and distribution. Advisory notes: (1) 336 mailing addresses contain residential indicators (APT/UNIT/LOT) — these are public record but consider whether product listing should note that mailing addresses may include personal addresses of sole proprietors. (2) 3,055 records use individual personal names as the dealer entity name — standard for sole proprietors and legally public, but worth noting in product documentation. (3) 57.9% of emails are personal-domain addresses (gmail/yahoo/etc) — normal for small independent dealers but buyers should be informed these are the officially registered business contact emails, not necessarily organizational addresses.
